reference.configuration: Original interpretation of the gun-armed M1/M2 arrangement in the black 1920 elevation. The 12-inch gun is ahead of the conning tower; later red M2 hangar/seaplane annotations are excluded. Profile and plan use shared stations. The plan and small fittings are simplified reconstructions, not copied shipyard linework.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
